rationale: Although price has crept above the 5-minute 9-EMA ($14.22) to $14.27, the current ask is already at the $14.30 invalidation level, meaning a market close right now would cross the 21 bps spread and lock in the full stop-loss amount anyway. Holding gives the $14.30 micro-resistance level a chance to reject the low-volume bounce while the broader market remains deeply negative (SPY -4.02%) and price remains well below session VWAP ($14.62). Flipping to long is unattractive against the severe market-wide downtrend and overhead VWAP resistance.
